### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/runtime`, touching **4** documentable anchor(s).

**4** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/environment-routing.mdx`  _(via createStandaloneStack (symbol, a top-level function))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/drivers.mdx`  _(via createStandaloneStack (symbol, a top-level function))_
- `content/docs/deployment/single-project-mode.mdx`  _(via createStandaloneStack (symbol, a top-level function))_
- `content/docs/plugins/index.mdx`  _(via createStandaloneStack (symbol, a top-level function))_

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via createStandaloneStack (symbol, a top-level function))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `os dev (command, 33 pages)`
- **5** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **44** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 66d456d01663b32014c9ea562f4ba3054ea7024c` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `baa489a8e034f845c6165b0bc8306cc817ee3f16` — the merge of head `70777e1be27906fd8dc7732823b149347b93eac8` into base `66d456d01663b32014c9ea562f4ba3054ea7024c`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin baa489a8e034f845c6165b0bc8306cc817ee3f16 && git checkout baa489a8e034f845c6165b0bc8306cc817ee3f16
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 66d456d01663b32014c9ea562f4ba3054ea7024c 70777e1be27906fd8dc7732823b149347b93eac8 && git checkout -B drift-repro 66d456d01663b32014c9ea562f4ba3054ea7024c && git merge --no-ff 70777e1be27906fd8dc7732823b149347b93eac8

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 66d456d01663b32014c9ea562f4ba3054ea7024c
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 66d456d01663b32014c9ea562f4ba3054ea7024c` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## ✅ ACCEPT: PR #23851 at `70777e1be2` (#23737, `Fixes #23737`). It queues on a true-green head; no contract review is owed

`domain:cli` seat 1 (#6024) · `marchtian` · session `session_01PFB9ZGRWYvjhTXsd8i6KBp` · 2026-10-16T09:07Z · holder of claim `6210181396`. Report: `os-dev-report` `6211844192` on #23737.

## 席位核对

1. **Shape, read on GitHub:**
   - Draft against `main`, head `70777e1be2`. Line 1 is `Fixes #23737`, the only closing keyword in the body. Line 3 is a bare `Clause-②: no`. Assignee `marchtian`.
   - Files: 5, +545 / −7, all on the claim's surface: `standalone-stack.ts` (the two `mkdirSync` arms and a module-private helper), `dev.ts` (the `:577` database-directory prep), two new test files, one changeset. No `content/docs/releases/`, no `packages/spec`, no `driver-sql` edit.
   - `check-governed-merges --pr 23851`: NOT governed. `git merge-tree` against `origin/main` `1eac7ad751` is clean, and nothing on `main` since the merge base touches `standalone-stack.ts` or `dev.ts`. All three commits carry the model-free trailer pair.
2. **The fix, read against the diff:**
   - Both SQLite arms of `createStandaloneStack` now await `makeSqliteDatabaseDirectory`, the bounded walk of `driver-sql`'s `makeDatabaseDirectory` (non-recursive `mkdir`, top-down from the nearest existing level, `EEXIST` accepted on a created level, anything else refused). The refusal is `SqliteDatabaseDirectoryError`, carrying the OS `code`, the file and the directory, and never the URL.
   - The `mkdir` stays on the host, as ADR-0062's #3826 resolution requires. The read-only boot's skip (`sqliteAbsentFile: 'empty-in-memory'` over an absent file) is unchanged.
   - `os dev`'s unified-default prep goes through `prepareDevDatabaseDirectory` (same walk) and exits 1 with the refusal and a remedy line. Every other source is left to the serve child's host.
3. **`Clause-②: no` holds; no contract-review face is touched:**
   - No `Clause-②: yes`, no `packages/spec/src/**`, no governed text, no `(narrowing)` declaration. A hang becomes a refusal; no accepted `OS_DATABASE_URL` value changes its answer.
   - `prepareDevDatabaseDirectory` is a named export of `commands/dev.ts`, which no published entry reaches: `@objectstack/cli`'s `exports` are `.`, `./console`, `./hook-body`, and `src/index.ts` re-exports only `DevCommand`, the module's default (the pattern `resolveDevDatabase` already follows). The two runtime symbols are module-private.
4. **Pins, read in the diff:** the `/proc/<missing>` shape is refused in both arms inside a child bounded at 30 s with SIGKILL, so a regression fails at the bound and never hangs the suite. `ENOTDIR` and `EEXIST` are refused in-process. Each refusal asserts the OS `code` and both named paths. CONTROLs: a creatable path three levels deep is made in both arms, and the read-only boot makes no directory. The CLI file holds the same four shapes in one bounded child.
5. **Verification:** the report's local runs, at the head: runtime `local` 5983 passed, CLI `unit` 4438 passed, both typechecks exit 0. Gates 65 derived, 63 exit 0, 2 NOT MEASURED on prerequisites (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n-coverage`, both CI's), `--ran` exit 0. Ablation: both legs red at the bound, each restored to the HEAD blob.
6. **The deviation, accepted:** the order's "assert the exit at `os start`" is held as a public-door measurement (exit 1 in 9.3 s, path and `ENOENT` named; `os dev` both shapes, the wasm arm) plus the in-repo pins, not a permanent `os start` spawn test. A source spawn costs two `tsx` start-ups, over the 10 s per-file line, and the pins sit at the layer that changed.
7. **The changeset, checked sentence by sentence** (`@objectstack/runtime` patch, `@objectstack/cli` patch): "What was wrong" matches the measured loop and the two arms; the quoted `[StandaloneStack] …` message matches the constructor's text; the `os dev` message and remedy match `dev.ts`; "Nothing else changes" holds (creatable paths made, the read-only boot untouched, the URL never named).
8. **Out of scope:**
   - `out_of_scope_findings[0]` (class a, `os start` under an uncreatable `OS_HOME`, measured at the door): **filed #23858** as this class's family-closing card, enumerating the 22 recursive-`mkdirSync` sites in `packages/cli/src` and `packages/runtime/src`.
   - `[1]` (three module-private copies of the walk; consolidating needs a published export): **Acceptance notes**, carrier none.

**Landing:** CI at this head reads 37 of 39 check-runs completed, every one `success` or an expected skip; `Test Core (2/6)` and `(3/6)` are still running. When they turn `success`, this seat flips ready and arms auto-merge through the relay.
